prompt_text: I want to try a tanning salon in Columbus. Which specific salons should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — first a couple quick clarifying questions so I give useful, specific picks:

1) Which Columbus do you mean (e.g., Columbus, OH vs Columbus, GA, IN, etc.)?  
2) Do you want UV tanning (beds/booths) or sunless spray tans? Or are you open to either?  
3) Any preferences: budget, distance/ZIP or neighborhood, membership vs one-off session, or special amenities (stand-up booth, red-light, airbrush technician, organic solutions)?

If you want to decide now without answering those, I can still help: below are the practical factors that determine which salons are worth calling, plus a ready list of questions to ask so you get the best place for your needs.

What to look for when choosing salons (why these matter)
- Spray vs UV options: spray tans are safer for fair skin/first-timers; UV gives natural melanin tanning but has skin-cancer risks. Choose according to skin type and comfort with UV exposure.  
- Technician training & solution brands: reputable spray salons will use known brands (Norvell, Versa, Mystic) and offer patch tests; trained techs give more natural results.  
- Equipment age & maintenance: newer bulbs/clean booths give better, faster UV results and reduce streaking/uneven tans.  
- Cleanliness & customer reviews: hygiene, towels, and booth cleanliness matter for both spray and UV.  
- Pricing transparency & membership terms: ask about package expiration, blackout dates, and any surprise fees.  
- Safety checks: look for staff asking about medications/skin conditions (some meds increase UV sensitivity).  
- Location & hours: convenient hours reduce skipping appointments.

Questions to ask when you call (quick script)
- Do you offer spray tans, UV tanning beds/booths, or both?  
- For spray: do you use Norvell/Versa/Mystic? Is the technician certified? Do you require or recommend a patch test? How long does a typical session take and how long does the tan last? Any prep/aftercare I should know?  
- For UV: what types of beds do you have (high-pressure, laydown, stand-up)? How old are the bulbs and how often are they replaced? Do you have express/bronzer beds? Do you provide eye protection?  
- Pricing: walk-in price, package prices, membership cost and cancellation/expiration policies, any taxes or extras?  
- Cleanliness & safety: how often are booths cleaned? Do you sanitize between customers? Do you screen for medications or skin conditions?  
- Availability: do I need an appointment? Typical wait time? Weekend/evening hours?  
- Any first-timer specials or recommendations for my skin type? (If you know your Fitzpatrick skin type, mention it.)

Safety reminder
- If you have very fair skin, a history of skin cancer, many moles, or take photosensitizing meds, avoid UV tanning — get a spray tan or check with your dermatologist first.

If you tell me which Columbus and whether you prefer spray or UV (and your ZIP or neighborhood), I’ll find 4–6 specific salons, give phone numbers and short reasons to call each one. Which Columbus and what kind of tanning do you want?
